channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Zema chama reajuste do Bolsa Família de 'medida eleitoreira' e propõe R$ 5 mil por carteira
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) labeled the Bolsa Família adjustment as an 'electoral measure' and proposed R$5,000 per job. The minimum benefit increased from R$600 to R$691.

item.title: Nunes Marques deve retirar impedimento em votações no STF após as eleições
item.description: Justice Kássio Nunes Marques should lift his recusal for STF votes after the elections, including the session regarding investigation against Alexandre de Moraes. This decision allows him to participate in trials after the electoral period.

item.title: A materialização do absurdo
item.description: The text suggests that a crisis at the STF could lead to Flávio Bolsonaro's election, depicting it as a surreal absurdity. Institutional crisis and political polarization are presented as concerning factors.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro afirma que reajuste do Bolsa Família durante eleições é 'ilegal' e 'proibido'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) criticized the 15% Bolsa Família adjustment announced by Lula's government (PT), calling it illegal and prohibited for being done during elections. There are 17 days left before the first round of the presidential election.

item.title: Em 2024, STF considerou inconstitucional aumento de Bolsa Família em ano eleitoral
item.description: In August 2024, the STF partially annulled the constitutional amendment proposed by the Bolsonaro government that allowed increased social benefits such as Bolsa Família and Gas Assistance during an election year. The Court ruled that such measures disrupt the electoral period and violate constitutional principles.

item.title: Lula vai ao TSE contra Flávio após acusação de “dividir poder” com Moraes
item.description: Lula's coalition filed a lawsuit with the TSE against Flávio Bolsonaro, requesting a right of reply over statements accusing the president of sharing power with Minister Moraes. The campaign questions the veracity of the claims, deeming them misinformation about Brazil's constitutional framework. The case was assigned to Minister André Mendonça, with a preliminary injunction requested to suspend rebroadcasting the ad.

item.title: O tradutor infiel: o STF entre o espetáculo e a fulanização
item.description: The STF is portrayed as a 'faithless translator' favoring political interests and institutional mediation over legal certainty, undermining decisional consistency and turning proceedings into media performances via TV Justiça. The text highlights institutional flaws and key figures contributing to the court's reputational crisis.

item.title: Novo avalia recorrer contra decisão de Lula de reajustar Bolsa Família a 2 semanas do primeiro turno
item.description: The Novo party is evaluating legal action to challenge Lula's decision to adjust Bolsa Família 17 days before the first round, viewing it as an electorally motivated measure. The party sees weakness in the PT campaign, especially after Supreme Court criticisms and polls placing Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro segura facão falso e defende castração química de estupradores
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Presidential candidate, waved a fake knife at a rally in Recife and advocated chemical castration for rapists. The event is part of his electoral campaign in Northeast Brazil. The speech sparked reactions regarding public safety and human rights.

item.title: Pesquisa aponta que solidão e exaustão ampliam abstenção nas urnas
item.description: The Termômetro do Bem Viver survey reveals that loneliness, mental exhaustion and digital dependency are the main factors linked to voter abstention in Brazil, with 30 million voters choosing not to vote. Young people aged 18 to 34 represent 44% of the 'unconnected', individuals who rarely vote or have abandoned voting due to feeling isolated and powerless to change reality.

item.title: Em SC, Renan Santos diz que acionará o TSE contra aumento do Bolsa Família em período eleitoral
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from Missão to the Presidency, announced a lawsuit against the TSE over the 15% increase in Bolsa Família, criticizing Lula's government for considering the adjustment a 'vote buying'. During his campaign in Chapecó, he also proposed judicial reforms and emphasized support for agribusiness.

item.title: Veja ligações de ministros do STF com o caso Master
item.description: Investigations reveal connections between former banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, and five STF ministers, raising concerns about influence over the case handling in court. Messages and documents extracted by the Federal Police indicate personal and professional contacts between Vorcaro and the judges.

item.title: AGU validou reajuste do Bolsa Família em período eleitoral
item.description: The AGU validated the Bolsa Família adjustment based on INPC, stating there is no electoral restriction, as it is an inflationary correction without expanding beneficiaries. The family floor increased from R$ 600 to R$ 691. The decision was justified as an exercise of executive authority under law, outside the scope of the Electoral Law.

item.title: Trump exigiu eleições “livres” e proteção a “dissidentes” do Brasil
item.description: Confidential documents reveal that the Trump administration demanded Brazil not arrest or prevent political dissidents from participating in the 2026 elections, in addition to ensuring free and fair elections. The proposal was part of a 21-point commercial agreement and was rejected by Lula's government.

item.title: Moraes aparece em 72% dos posts sobre Master durante sessão do STF
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes was mentioned in 72.8% of publications about the Master case on September 15, 2026, during the STF's suspended hearing. DSC LAB analysis showed 12,952 mentions of the minister, with 55% critical tone, mainly due to suspected irregularities involving his wife's law firm. Minister André Mendonça was also heavily cited, with 7,652 publications.

item.title: Flávio não vai acionar TSE contra reajuste do Bolsa Família
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro decided not to sue the TSE against Lula's campaign over the Bolsa Família adjustment before the 2026 elections. According to O Antagonista, the senator's campaign strategy is to avoid judicialization and stay focused on the electoral race.

item.title: Crise no STF e queda em pesquisas determina ajustes em campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign will be adjusted in the final stretch due to declining polls and STF crisis, shifting toward more direct political confrontations and sharper criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro. The president will emphasize national sovereignty while reducing focus on legacy messaging to align with current electoral dynamics.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não tem ajuda do governo Trump nas eleições: ‘Quem resolve é a gente aqui’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) denied receiving support from the Trump administration in the 2026 elections, stating the vote will be decided domestically. He criticized Brazil's diplomacy under Lula and pledged to restore international respect. Leaked documents show the U.S. demanded political dissidents' participation in the election following the 50% tariff.

item.title: A distância entre Lula e Bolsonaro no Datafolha a três semanas da eleição de 2022
item.description: Datafolha releases a new 2026 electoral poll showing Lula at 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 35% in the first round, with Augusto Cury in third place at 6%. Compared to 2022, the race is tighter, especially in the second round, where the two candidates are technically tied.

item.title: Wellington Dias nega relação entre reajuste do Bolsa Família e eleição
item.description: Minister Wellington Dias denied that the 15.04% raise in Bolsa Família is linked to the 2026 elections, stating it is part of Lula's social agenda. Announced 17 days before the first round, the measure sparked opposition criticism over its political timing.

item.title: Lula usa Bolsa Família como moeda eleitoral e dá xeque-mate em Flávio, que fica de mãos atadas
item.description: Lula announced a Bolsa Família adjustment two weeks before the first round, using it as electoral currency to weaken Flávio Bolsonaro, who leads in polling. The measure aims to neutralize the PL's appeal in the Northeast, where Lula has a strong electoral base and the majority of program beneficiaries.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos à Presidência da República do Brasil nas eleições 2026
item.description: Brazil's 2026 presidential elections will feature 13 officially registered candidates following the party conventions, including incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) seeking reelection and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) representing the Bolsonaro legacy. Jair Bolsonaro (PL) is ineligible due to imprisonment for attempting a coup d'état, and Pablo Marçal (PRTB) had his candidacy rejected by the TSE.

item.title: Reajuste de Lula ao Bolsa Família não é o maior já feito em ano eleitoral, apesar de tempo recorde
item.description: President Lula announced a 15% adjustment to Bolsa Família, to take effect in October, between the first and second electoral rounds. Despite the strategic timing, it is the smallest adjustment in an election year since 2014. The largest increase was made by Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, raising the Auxílio Brasil from R$ 400 to R$ 600 (50%).

item.title: Campanha de Lula na TV tenta colar em Flavio a pecha de 'mentiroso'
item.description: The PT's electoral broadcast on Thursday night aims to link Flávio Bolsonaro with the image of a liar, using a strategy already tested in digital campaigns. The approach is based on qualitative research showing voter distrust toward the senator. The petista campaign bets on credibility charges as a central point against the right-wing candidate.

item.title: Futura/100% Cidades: Flávio Bolsonaro aparece à frente de Lula no 2º turno
item.description: The latest Futura/100% Cidades poll shows senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading president Lula (PT) in a hypothetical 2026 second-round runoff. The survey, released Wednesday, reveals a narrow edge for the PL candidate over the PT incumbent in a direct matchup. These projections remain preliminary and could shift before election day.

item.title: Reforma tributária na pauta eleitoral: entre continuidade e revisão de regimes
item.description: With candidates officially registered, the debate on the future of the Brazilian tax system centers on the continuity of the tax reform, focusing on the implementation of the dual IVA and the digitalization of collections, avoiding ruptures that could cause legal insecurity. While the current government bets on the stability of the schedule and regulatory predictability, the opposition proposes adjustments in tax rates, regime reviews, and reduction of tax benefits without changing the basic structure of the reform.

item.title: Lula é aprovado por 44,1% e desaprovado por 53,1%, diz pesquisa
item.description: A 2026 Futura/100% Cidades poll shows Lula approved by 44.1% and disapproved by 53.1% of voters. In a simulated first round, Lula leads with 38.3% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 37.7%, but in the second round Flávio pulls ahead with 48.1% versus Lula's 43.7%. Rejection rates show Lula at 49.7% and Flávio at 45.3%, according to the TSE-registered survey.

item.title: Lula é rejeitado por 49,7% do eleitorado, Flávio por 45,3%, diz pesquisa
item.description: Poll Futura/100% Cidades (Sep 17, 2026) shows Lula with 49.7% rejection and Flávio Bolsonaro with 45.3%, while in the 1st round Lula leads with 38.3% vs Flávio's 37.7%; in a simulated 2nd round Flávio leads with 48.1% vs Lula's 43.7%, within the 2.2-point margin of error.

item.title: Em disputa estadual acirrada, caciques alagoanos correm risco de ficar sem mandato
item.description: The 2026 Alagoas election is poised for major shifts, with traditional figures like Renan Filho and Renan Calheiros facing strong competition in a tightly balanced race. The contest reflects local polarization and generational change, with established political dynasties at risk of losing ground.

item.title: Flávio tem 48,1% contra 43,7% de Lula no 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Futura/100% Cidades poll (Sept 17, 2026) shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 48.1% vs 43.7% for Lula (PT) in a 2nd-round runoff, within the ±2.2pp margin of error. Across five simulated matchups, Lula stays between 44.5% and 44.7%, while opponents range from 39.3% to 45.1%. In the 1st round, Lula leads with 38.3% to Flávio's 37.7%, and 53.1% disapprove of the president's performance.

item.title: Crusoé: Candidato de Ratinho Jr. no Paraná despenca e pedetista sobe, indica AtlasIntel
item.description: AtlasIntel polling data shows PSD candidate Sandro Alex, backed by Ratinho Jr., dropped 6.5 percentage points in one week from 25.1% to 18.6%, while Requião Filho (PDT), supported by Lula, rose to second place in the Paraná gubernatorial race.

item.title: Pedido de Trump sobre “dissidentes políticos” circulou só em nível técnico
item.description: The Trump administration sent a diplomatic proposal demanding Brazil not restrict the participation of 'political dissidents' in the 2026 elections, but Itamaraty downplayed it as a technical document that never advanced in negotiations. Brazilian officials rejected the 'dissident' label for Jair Bolsonaro, viewing him solely as a political opponent.

item.title: Mendonça rebate Gilmar e nega ter transformado STF em “palanque”
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça dismissed criticism from Justice Gilmar Mendes regarding the release of a PF report, denying claims that he turned the STF into an 'election platform.' Mendonça emphasized his compliance with legal procedures and supported creating a conduct code for the Court. The dispute highlights internal tensions amid ongoing political investigations.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta quinta-feira (17)
item.description: On Thursday (17), the presidential candidates carry out a series of public events, including walks, parades, and visits to institutions. Most candidates are engaged in grassroots actions, such as interacting with voters and promoting social causes, including children's and adolescents' rights. Some candidates, like Flávio Bolsonaro and Renan Santos, lead parades through cities, while others, like Lula and Samara Martins, hold walks and meetings with supporters.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes chama Mendonça de ‘pixuleco eleitoral’ e compara o Caso Master à Lava Jato
item.description: Gilmar Mendes harshly criticized colleague André Mendonça over the Banco Master case, calling him an 'electoral puppet' and accusing him of seeking political dividends. He defended Paulo Gonet and likened the case to Lava Jato, escalating tensions within the STF.

item.title: Supremo erode a própria moral de julgador
item.description: The STF faces questions about its legitimacy to judge political cases, particularly regarding its role in determining guilt and innocence. The text highlights concerns about the erosion of the STF's institutional morality.

item.title: Raphinha supera início mais goleador da carreira de Messi
item.description: Raphinha started the 2026/27 season with a historic performance for Barcelona, scoring 11 goals in three games, surpassing Messi's best career start. The Brazilian stood out with a hat-trick in the 7-2 victory over Racing Santander, helping Barca lead LaLiga with a perfect record.

item.title: Augusto Cury recua em pesquisa e perde força para outro nome da terceira via
item.description: In the latest AtlasIntel poll, Augusto Cury dropped from 6.6% to 3.5%, while Renan Santos held third place with 5.1%, widening his lead. The race for third place remains distant from front-runners Lula (44.1%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (41.7%).

item.title: Governo Trump exigiu que Brasil permita "dissidentes políticos" na eleição
item.description: The Trump administration demanded that Brazil allow 'political dissidents' to participate in the 2026 elections in a document sent in October 2025 during tariff negotiations. The request, which included 21 demands, was not accepted by the Brazilian government, according to Itamaraty sources who deemed the proposal unfeasible.

item.title: Mendonça rebate Gilmar, nega vazamentos e diz que nunca 'transformou plenário em picadeiro'
item.description: Justice André Mendonça refuted criticism from Chief Justice Gilmar Mendes regarding the decision to lift the seals on documents in the Master case, denying he turned the Supreme Court floor into a 'soapbox' and asserting the decision was legally justified. Mendonça also denied involvement in any leaks and pointed out that calls for publicity came from those claiming outrage over the release. The clash highlights internal tensions within Brazil's Supreme Court over the case’s handling.

item.title: Os três fatores estatísticos que podem decidir as eleições a favor de Lula ou Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The 2026 elections may be determined by three statistical factors: the dilution of votes among other candidates in the first round, the behavior of undecided voters, and abstention rates. These elements can benefit either Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) or Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), particularly due to voting trends across age groups and the historical tendency to favor the incumbent.

item.title: Lula merece afundar com o STF
item.description: The STF crisis undermines Lula's re-election campaign, per a AtlasIntel poll projecting Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a first-round matchup against the PT candidate. The article frames this as poetic justice for Lula.

item.title: PT pede ao STF acesso à investigação sobre ACM Neto no Caso Master
item.description: The PT-BA and the PT-PCdoB-PV federation requested full access to the Master Case investigation files involving ACM Neto, a candidate for Bahia governor in 2026. The move seeks to check for unequal treatment in investigations between PT members and Neto, following a denied police search warrant in the Overclean operation by Minister Nunes Marques, then-president of the TSE.

item.title: Gilmar questiona decisão da 2ª Turma do STF que afastou Andrei da PF
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes questions the speed and lack of communication in the decision of the STF's 2nd Chamber to suspend Andrei Rodrigues from the Federal Police, criticizing the handling of the case by Luiz Fux and André Mendonça. He highlights the short interval between granting the injunction and forming the majority to uphold it, warning about risks to judicial independence.

item.title: Como está a disputa Lula X Flávio Bolsonaro no maior colégio do Sul, segundo pesquisa
item.description: A survey by AtlasIntel shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro leading voter intentions in Paraná against President Lula da Silva, with 53.7% versus 34% in the first round. In all simulated runoff scenarios, Lula loses to all possible opponents in the state.

item.title: Pesquisa PoderData mostra empate entre Lula e Flávio em 1º e 2º turnos
item.description: A PoderData survey released on September 17, 2026, shows a technical tie between President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in both the first and second rounds. In the first round, Lula leads by one percentage point (37% vs. 36%), while the second-round scenario is reversed, with Flávio ahead (46% vs. 44%). Additional second-round scenarios feature Augusto Cury (Avante) as the third candidate, where Lula ties with him and Flávio leads comfortably.

item.title: TCU abre fiscalização sobre uso do Palácio da Alvorada em live de Lula
item.description: The TCU has opened an investigation into the use of the Alvorada Palace during a live stream by Lula's campaign, following a complaint by federal deputy Ubiratan Sanderson (PL-RS), who questions whether public resources were indirectly used. Lula's campaign claims only campaign-owned equipment was used, while political opponents demand restrictions on public property usage for electoral purposes.

item.title: As boas notícias para Flávio Bolsonaro em nova pesquisa sobre a disputa contra Lula
item.description: A new AtlasIntel survey shows Flávio Bolsonaro gaining ground in the presidential race against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, narrowing their gap in the first round. The senator rose from 37.4% to 41.7%, while Lula moved from 43% to 44.1%, cutting the PT leader's lead from 5.6 to 2.4 points. In the runoff, Flávio remains slightly ahead, though the tie persists within the margin of error.

item.title: Kinea vê bolsa brasileira descontada pelos juros e define caminhos para investimentos antes de eleições
item.description: Kinea notes that the discount in the Brazilian stock market is more related to the high cost of money (real interest rates near 8%) than to the quality of listed companies. The report projects that a firmer fiscal policy can reduce rates and reprice equities, recommending portfolios with less interest-rate-sensitive companies and sectors such as banks, retail, and utilities.

item.title: Crusoé: Rejeição de João Campos supera a de Raquel em 12 pontos, indica AtlasIntel
item.description: AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll shows rejection of former mayor João Campos (36.9%) exceeds that of Governor Raquel Lyra (24.9%) by 12 percentage points. Despite this, Lyra leads voting intentions while Campos runs as Lula's candidate for Pernambuco state government.
